title: PSX Character Library v1.15: Bloom added
bodyHtml:
Bloom is in the Library: 14 adult crew of a deep space mining station after a fungal infection took them, from the rigger and the ore miner in orange to the EVA technician, the captain, the galley cook and the first host, the growth thickest of all on him, 42 skinned entities, rigged on the same skeleton with the same 45 clips as every other pack here. That makes 29 packs and 405 characters on this page.

If you own the Library, download again at no extra cost. Bloom joins the Occult and Space Horror archive beside Hollow Congregation, Deep Station and Pale Hours (now 857 MB), so that is the only file you need. The other ten archives changed only in their root files (Readme, catalogue and manifest now list 29 packs); the packs inside them are the same bytes as before.

Changelog, v1.15.0:

  • Added Bloom: 14 PSX Space Horror Infected Crew: Rigger, Lab technician, Security officer, Medic, Captain, Galley cook, EVA technician, Miner, Pilot, Comms officer, Reactor tech, Executive, The first host, Hydroponics tech.
  • Occult and Space Horror archive: now Hollow Congregation, Deep Station, Pale Hours and Bloom.
  • Readme, CATALOGUE and manifest updated to 29 packs and 405 characters.

Bloom is also sold on its own page: https://csaf.itch.io/bloom-psx-space-horror-infected-crew

How we tested it: every file in the eleven archives was read back and checked against the build its own page serves (4449 files). One pack from each archive was extracted and run through our pack gate, and a blank Godot 4.7 project imported all 462 of their GLBs with no errors.

The price: $19.99 today. A rise to $24.99 for new buyers is announced for 7 December 2026 in its own post here; it goes ahead only if the Library has sold at least three times at its full price by that day, and any later change waits for the sales that follow. If you already own it, nothing changes for you.

Free first: one character from every one of these packs is free in the PSX Characters Sampler.

Count so far: 31 live PSX listings, 9 of them sold, 34 purchases in total.

For anything, post a comment on the page. If the Library helps your game, a quick rating is the best way to support the next pack.

Made with AI tools: the bodies were generated by scripts an AI system wrote, and every texture is an AI image model's painting projected onto the mesh. The skeleton and clips are the CC0 Quaternius Universal Animation Library.
